editorial:
Imagine wanting to be a famous movie star so badly that you're willing to fake a car crash just to get noticed. That is exactly what Oscar does in this wild ride of a comedy. He is a guy with big dreams but very little luck, and his plan to get a stuntman job goes horribly wrong when he accidentally hurts a young actress. Instead of calling for help, he panics and brings her back to his place to hide the evidence. The whole movie feels like a chaotic series of bad decisions that keep piling up, creating a funny and stressful situation where you can't help but wonder how much worse things can actually get for him.

What really makes this work is how the lead actor captures that feeling of desperation. The timing is great, and the way the plot spirals out of control keeps you glued to the screen. While some of the 80s humor might feel a bit dated, the heart of the story is still relatable. You should definitely check this out if you love stories about people digging themselves into a deeper hole.
endingExplained: In the final act, Oscar's web of lies finally collapses. After all the chaos and pretending, the truth about the staged accident and the girl's injury comes out. Instead of ending in total disaster, the situation leads to an unexpected romantic spark between Oscar and the actress. He realizes that chasing fame through tricks isn't the way to go, and the movie wraps up with them finding a genuine connection despite the crazy start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves awkward comedies and underdog stories.
